zh: 从压低的眉毛下怒视，嘴唇紧抿
en: an angry glare from under lowered brows, the lips pressed tight

zh: 愤怒地喊叫，嘴张大露出牙齿，眉毛用力压低
en: shouting in anger, the mouth wide open showing the teeth, the brows drawn down hard

zh: 咆哮状，鼻子皱起，上唇卷起，露出一侧牙齿
en: a snarl, the nose wrinkled and the upper lip curled to bare the teeth on one side

zh: 咬紧牙关发怒，嘴唇向后拉，眉头紧锁
en: rage through clenched teeth, the lips pulled back, the brows knitted

zh: 不耐烦地看向一侧，眉毛压低，嘴唇抿成一条线
en: an annoyed look to the side, brows lowered, lips pressed into a flat line

zh: 挫败感，嘴唇用力抿紧，眉头拧在一起
en: frustration, the lips pressed hard, the brows knitted and pulled together

zh: 暴怒，眼睛在压低的眉毛下瞪大，露出牙齿
en: furious, wide staring eyes under lowered brows, the teeth bared

zh: 强压怒火的斜视，头转过去，眼睛从压低的眉毛下斜瞪
en: a seething side-eye, the head turned and the eyes glaring sideways under lowered brows

zh: 一边眉毛抬起一边压低，嘴扯向一侧，头微微歪着
en: puzzled, one brow up and one down, the mouth pulled to one side, the head tilted

zh: 抬眼望向别处思考，嘴唇抿着扯向一侧
en: thinking, looking up and away, the lips pressed and pulled to one side

zh: 一边眉毛高抬，另一只眼眯起，嘴唇抿紧
en: skeptical, one eyebrow raised, the other eye narrowed, the lips pressed

zh: 犹疑，嘴唇噘起推向一侧，目光移开
en: doubtful, the lips pursed and pushed to one side, looking away

zh: 用力专注，眉毛压低并拢，眼睛眯起
en: concentrating hard, the brows lowered and drawn together, the eyes narrowed

zh: 厌恶，鼻子皱起，上唇抬起，眉毛压低
en: disgust, the nose wrinkled, the upper lip raised and the brows lowered

zh: 恶心作呕，嘴张开下坠，鼻子皱起，眼睛眯起
en: gagging in disgust, the mouth open and pulled down, the nose wrinkled, the eyes squinting

zh: 轻蔑，一侧嘴角上扯，下巴抬起
en: contempt, one corner of the mouth pulled up and in, the chin raised

zh: 厌腻，嘴唇噘起抿紧，鼻子微微皱起
en: distaste, the lips pursed and pressed, the nose slightly wrinkled

zh: 翻白眼，眼睛向上翻，嘴唇抿平
en: an eye roll, the eyes turned up, the lips pressed flat

zh: 一只眼睛眨动，带着俏皮的微笑
en: a wink with one eye closed and a playful smile

zh: 俏皮地噘嘴，嘴唇向前推，眼睛柔和地垂下
en: a playful pout, the lips pushed out, the eyes softly lowered

zh: 含羞地低着头，从下往上看，带一丝微笑
en: a coy look, the head lowered and the eyes looking up with a small smile

zh: 眼皮半垂的朦胧眼神，淡淡微笑，嘴唇微张
en: heavy-lidded bedroom eyes with a faint smile and the lips just parted

zh: 轻咬下唇，带着一点笑意，眼睛半垂
en: biting the lower lip with a hint of a smile, eyes half lowered

zh: 越过肩膀回头一瞥，带一点微笑
en: a glance back over the shoulder with a little smile

zh: 送飞吻，嘴唇噘起，眼睛几乎闭上
en: blowing a kiss, the lips puckered and the eyes nearly closed

zh: 轻轻的闭嘴微笑，脸颊微微抬起，眼睛放松
en: a soft closed-mouth smile with slightly lifted cheeks and relaxed eyes

zh: 温暖友好的微笑，笑意到达眼睛，脸颊抬起，眼睛轻轻眯起
en: a warm, friendly smile that reaches the eyes, cheeks raised and eyes gently narrowed

zh: 大大的露齿笑，上下牙都露出来，脸颊高高抬起，眼睛笑成缝
en: a big beaming grin showing the upper and lower teeth, cheeks high and eyes crinkled

zh: 大大的闭嘴灿烂笑容，脸颊顶起，眼睛弯成月牙
en: a wide closed-mouth beaming smile, cheeks pushed up and eyes crinkled into crescents

zh: 温柔的微笑，头歪向一侧，柔和亲切
en: a gentle smile with the head tilted to one side, soft and kind

zh: 兴奋的张嘴笑，眼睛睁大，眉毛抬起
en: an excited open-mouth smile with wide eyes and raised eyebrows

zh: 满足的微笑，眼睛安详地闭着，下巴微微抬起
en: a content smile with the eyes peacefully closed and the chin slightly up

zh: 自豪的闭嘴微笑，下巴抬起
en: a proud closed-mouth smile with the chin raised

zh: 张大嘴开怀大笑，露出牙齿，眼睛被脸颊挤起
en: laughing out loud with the mouth wide open, teeth showing and eyes squeezed by the cheeks

zh: 仰头大笑，眼睛几乎闭上，嘴张得很大
en: a big head-back laugh, eyes almost shut and mouth wide open

zh: 低头歪头轻笑，嘴唇微微张开，眼睛弯起
en: a giggle with the head ducked and tilted, lips barely parted, eyes crinkled

zh: 转头看向别处大笑，嘴张开，眼睛笑眯眯
en: laughing while turning away, mouth open, eyes squinting with joy

zh: 闭嘴低笑，嘴唇抿成宽宽的笑，脸颊鼓起
en: a closed-mouth chuckle, lips pressed in a wide smile, cheeks bunched up

zh: 笑到流泪，眼睛几乎挤闭，眉毛中间抬起，嘴张得很大
en: crying with laughter, eyes squeezed nearly shut, brows lifted in the middle, mouth wide open

zh: 歪着嘴笑，一边嘴角更高，微微露齿
en: a lopsided laugh, one corner of the mouth higher, teeth just showing

zh: 神情低落，内侧眉毛抬起，嘴角下垂，眼睛向下看
en: a downcast look, the inner eyebrows raised, the mouth corners turned down and the eyes looking down

zh: 快要哭出来，下唇向上噘起，内侧眉毛上提
en: about to cry, lower lip pushed up into a pout, the inner brows pulled up

zh: 放声哭泣，嘴张开下坠，眼睛挤紧，内侧眉毛高抬
en: openly crying, the mouth stretched open and turned down, eyes squeezed, inner brows high

zh: 难过地别开脸，内侧眉毛抬起，嘴角下垂
en: a sad look turned away, the inner brows raised and the mouth turned down

zh: 强忍眼泪，嘴唇紧抿发抖，下巴皱起，内侧眉毛高抬
en: holding back tears, the lips pressed tight and trembling, the chin bunched, the inner brows high

zh: 失望的表情，嘴唇抿着下垂，眼睛垂下
en: a disappointed face, the lips pressed and turned down, the eyes lowered

zh: 悲恸，眼睛闭着，头低下，眉毛中间上提，嘴角下垂
en: grief, the eyes closed, the head bowed, the brows drawn up in the middle and the mouth turned down

zh: 惆怅苦乐参半的神情，悲伤抬起的眉毛下带着淡淡微笑
en: a wistful, bittersweet look, a faint smile under sad raised brows

zh: 恐惧，眼睛睁大，眉毛抬起并拢，嘴向后拉开
en: fear, the eyes wide open, the brows raised and drawn together, the mouth stretched back

zh: 惊恐尖叫，嘴拉得大开，眼睛瞪圆
en: a terrified scream, the mouth stretched wide open, eyes bulging

zh: 紧张地看向一侧，眉毛中间抬起，嘴唇拉紧
en: a nervous look to the side, the brows raised in the middle, the lips pulled tight

zh: 担忧，眉头拧起、中间抬高，嘴绷紧
en: worried, the brows knitted and raised in the middle, the mouth tense

zh: 焦虑地咬着下唇，内侧眉毛抬起
en: anxious, biting the lower lip, the inner brows raised

zh: 疼得缩瑟，眼睛挤紧，脸皱成一团，头转开
en: a wince, the eyes squeezed, the face screwed up and the head turning away

zh: 吓呆了，瞪大眼睛直视，眉毛抬起，嘴唇微张
en: frozen in fright, staring with wide eyes, the brows up and the lips barely parted

zh: 中性放松的表情，嘴闭着，眼睛直视前方
en: a neutral, relaxed expression, mouth closed, eyes looking straight ahead

zh: 专注，眉毛微微压低，眼睛眯起
en: focused, the brows slightly lowered and the eyes narrowed

zh: 坚定，下巴绷紧，嘴唇抿着，眉毛压低
en: determined, the jaw set, the lips pressed and the brows drawn down

zh: 严厉，眉毛压低硬视，嘴角下垂
en: stern, a hard look with lowered brows and a downturned mouth

zh: 平静安详，眼睛闭着，面部放松
en: calm and serene, the eyes closed, the face relaxed

zh: 专心倾听，头微微转过去并歪着
en: listening attentively, the head slightly turned and tilted

zh: 头转成 3/4 侧，平静稳定地注视镜头
en: a calm, steady stare at the camera with the head turned three-quarters

zh: 羞涩的微笑，头低着歪向一侧，眼睛向下看
en: a shy smile, the head bowed and tilted, the eyes looking down

zh: 尴尬，紧绷地咧嘴笑，转开脸
en: embarrassed, a tight sheepish grin, turning away

zh: 腼腆，小小的抿嘴笑，眼睛垂下
en: bashful, a small pressed smile, the eyes lowered

zh: 局促，嘴唇拉平抿紧，眼睛飘开
en: awkward, the lips stretched flat and pressed, the eyes darting away

zh: 低着头羞涩地向上偷看，带一点微笑
en: peeking up shyly from a lowered head with a small smile

zh: 腮帮鼓起憋着气，眼睛睁大
en: puffed-out cheeks holding a breath, the eyes wide

zh: 鱼嘴脸，嘴唇推成紧紧的 O 形，眼睛睁大
en: a fish face, the lips pushed into a tight O, the eyes wide

zh: 斗鸡眼的搞怪脸，带着傻笑
en: a cross-eyed silly face with a goofy smile

zh: 自拍鸭子嘴，眉毛抬起
en: a duck-face pout for a selfie, the brows up

zh: 傻乎乎的笑，一只眼睛挤闭，嘴扯向一边
en: a goofy grin with one eye squeezed shut and the mouth pulled sideways

zh: 夸张的卡通震惊脸，下巴掉到最低
en: an over-the-top cartoon shock face, the jaw dropped as far as it goes

zh: 一边嘴角抬起的坏笑，眼睛微微眯起
en: a smirk, one corner of the mouth raised, the eyes slightly narrowed

zh: 自鸣得意，眼睛半闭，闭嘴微笑，下巴抬起
en: self-satisfied, eyes half closed, a closed smile, the chin up

zh: 一边眉毛高高挑起，带着了然的坏笑
en: one eyebrow raised high with a knowing smirk

zh: 安静的自信，淡淡的闭嘴微笑，下巴微微抬起
en: quietly confident, a slight closed smile and the chin a little raised

zh: 狡黠的斜视，半带微笑，头转过去眼睛往回看
en: a sly side-eye with a half smile, the head turned and the eyes looking back

zh: 得意的歪嘴咧笑，一边眉毛抬起
en: a cocky lopsided grin, one brow up

zh: 吃惊倒吸气，眉毛猛地抬起，眼睛睁大，嘴张开
en: a gasp of surprise, the eyebrows shot up, the eyes wide and the mouth dropped open

zh: 轻微惊讶，眉毛抬起，眼睛稍睁大，嘴唇微张
en: mild surprise, the brows raised, the eyes a little wider, the lips just parted

zh: 震惊到下巴掉下来，嘴大张着，眼睛瞪得很大
en: jaw-dropping shock, the mouth hanging wide open and the eyes huge

zh: 愉快的惊喜，张嘴笑，眉毛抬起，眼睛睁大
en: a delighted surprise, an open-mouth smile with raised brows and wide eyes

zh: 受惊，头往后缩，眼睛睁大，嘴横向拉开
en: startled, pulling the head back, eyes wide, the mouth stretched sideways

zh: 惊叹，抬头望，眉毛抬起，嘴微微张开
en: in awe, looking up with raised brows and the mouth softly open

zh: 困倦，眼皮垂下一半，面部松弛
en: sleepy, the eyelids drooping halfway, the face slack

zh: 大大的哈欠，嘴张得很大，眼睛挤得半闭
en: a big yawn, the mouth wide open and the eyes squeezed half shut

zh: 无聊，眼皮沉重，嘴推向一侧，看向别处
en: bored, heavy eyelids, the mouth pushed to one side, looking away

zh: 精疲力尽，眼睛耷拉，嘴微微张着
en: exhausted, droopy eyes, the mouth hanging slightly open

zh: 毫无兴趣，平直的注视，眼皮压低，嘴唇抿着
en: unimpressed, a flat stare with lowered lids and pressed lips

zh: 打瞌睡，眼睛闭着，头歪向一侧垂下
en: dozing off, the eyes closed and the head drooping to one side

zh: 犹疑，嘴唇噘起推向一侧，目光瞟开
en: doubtful, the lips pursed and pushed to one side, glancing away

zh: 尴尬地咧嘴，嘴角横向拉开，眉毛抬起
en: an awkward grimace, the mouth stretched sideways and the brows raised

zh: 强烈的厌腻，嘴唇卷起，鼻子深深皱起
en: strong distaste, the lips curled, the nose wrinkled hard and the brows lowered

zh: 微微受惊，头轻轻后缩，眼睛睁大
en: startled, the head pulled back slightly, the eyes wide and the brows raised
